title: SIRA self-learning RAG
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for offline corpus-discriminative Seed Pack enrichment (SIRA), cross-domain structural isomorphism indexing (RA-RFT), execution-report reflection into sub-2ms edge shim rules (MR-Search) and bounded DGM-H proposals gated by an independent verifier.
boundaries: DGM-H self-improvement proposals never self-verify: proposer_worker_id and proposer_key_id must differ from the verifier before any owner review.
Compiled edge shim rules stay deterministic, zero-model and strictly under the 2.0 ms latency budget.
Offline SIRA enrichment and benchmark artifacts never mutate evaluator controls or widen visibility beyond surface_only.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for single-shot SIRA pack enrichment, RA-RFT structural analogy retrieval, MR-Search sub-2ms shim compilation and DGM-H verified proposals

value.lets_workers: Enrich Task Objects and Seed Packs offline with corpus-discriminative vocabulary, I/O signatures and predictive query expansions so multi-round exploratory search collapses into one single-shot retrieval, match structural problem isomorphisms across surface domains, compile execution-report reflections into sub-2ms deterministic edge shims and gate bounded DGM-H proposals through an independent verifier.

flow.when: Extract discriminative vocabulary, I/O type signatures, predictive query expansions and 12 structural isomorphism frames across the pack library.
Reflect over prior Task execution reports (went_right, went_wrong, unknowns, latency and token burn) to emit deterministic < 2 ms routing and pruning rules.
Check bounded DGM-H retrieval improvement proposals with a distinct verifier worker and key before owner review.

value.worked_example: Synthetic 4-pack pharmacy cross-domain query bundle recomputed in test_sira_rag.py: baseline surface lexical search misses (audio-loudness-gate), single-shot SIRA + RA-RFT retrieves two-step-kit-review via independent-two-step-review isomorphism, compiles 1 deterministic shim rule, rejects self-verification and approves independent verification.

nouns.title: Guardrail: DGM-H self-improvement proposals require an independent verifier worker and key
nouns.category_reason: Enforces separation of duties on self-learning RAG updates so no worker promotes its own retrieval or shim changes.

value.rule: Every DGM-H proposal requires verification by a worker whose worker_id and key_id both differ from the proposer before entering owner review.
value.how_it_is_checked: DgmHIndependentVerifier.verify_proposal returns status 409 and rejected whenever proposer_worker_id == verifier_worker_id or proposer_key_id == verifier_key_id.

nouns.title: Guardrail: compiled edge shim rules execute deterministically in under 2.0 milliseconds
nouns.category_reason: Keeps pre-inference routing, context pruning and guardrail injection negligible on the critical path.

value.rule: Compiled edge shim rules invoke zero neural models and evaluate in strictly less than 2.0 milliseconds per query.
value.how_it_is_checked: evaluate_shim records wall-clock latency_ms and DgmHIndependentVerifier rejects any rule >= 2.0 ms.

nouns.title: Guardrail: retrieval enrichment and reflection never alter holdout queries or evaluator gates
nouns.category_reason: Prevents Goodhart reward hacking when reflecting over execution reports.

value.rule: Self-improvement proposals may update predictive query expansions and shim trigger terms only while mutates_evaluator_controls stays false and holdout_regressions == 0.
value.how_it_is_checked: DgmHIndependentVerifier checks mutates_evaluator_controls is false, holdout_regressions == 0 and holdout_mrr_delta > 0.

nouns.title: Specification: SIRA offline enrichment, 12 RA-RFT isomorphism frames and 60-query benchmark
nouns.category_reason: Defines single-shot retrieval targets, structural frames and DGM-H verification fields.

nouns.title: Deterministic SIRA enrichment, RA-RFT hybrid fusion and DGM-H verification rules
nouns.category_reason: Zero-call indexing, scoring and verification rules for single-shot cross-domain Seed Pack retrieval.

enrichment_stages: corpus-discriminative TF-IDF specificity extraction (df <= 40% of packs)

nouns.title: Tool card: SiraNounEnricher, RaRftAnalogyIndex, MR-Search shim compiler and DGM-H verifier
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python standard-library package pinned by path, file count and digest.

value.name: SIRA self-learning RAG
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Enriches Seed Packs and Task Objects offline with discriminative vocabulary, I/O signatures and predictive query expansions.
Indexes 12 RA-RFT structural problem-isomorphism frames for single-shot cross-domain analogical retrieval.
Compiles Task execution reports into < 2 ms deterministic shim rules and verifies bounded DGM-H proposals via an independent verifier.
does_not: Allow self-approval of DGM-H proposals, mutate benchmark holdouts or exceed the 2.0 ms shim latency ceiling.

nouns.title: Template: single-shot SIRA + RA-RFT retrieval, shim compilation and DGM-H verification receipt

value.describes: top-1 pack before and after SIRA + RA-RFT enrichment, compiled shim count and independent DGM-H verification verdicts

nouns.title: Worked example input: cross-domain pharmacy separation-of-duties query across four synthetic Seed Packs
nouns.category_reason: Synthetic 4-pack analogical retrieval and DGM-H reflection bundle recomputed by test_sira_rag.py.

verbs.title: Enrich Seed Packs offline with SIRA discriminative terms and RA-RFT isomorphism frames
verbs.summary: Extract corpus-discriminative vocabulary, slot/output type signatures, predictive query expansions and 12 structural isomorphism frames so multi-round search collapses into one single-shot retrieval.
verbs.outcome: SHA-256-pinned SIRA + RA-RFT index supporting sub-2ms single-shot cross-domain retrieval.

slots.name: pack_corpus
slots.description: Pin of Seed Pack corpus to enrich offline.

steps: Run SiraNounEnricher.enrich_corpus across the input Seed Packs to compute discriminative TF-IDF terms, I/O signatures and predictive query expansions.
Build RaRftAnalogyIndex across all 12 structural problem-isomorphism frames.

acceptance.check: Every pack receives a deterministic enrichment_sha256 and single-shot retrieval completes in < 2.0 ms.

verbs.title: Compile Task execution-report reflections into deterministic sub-2ms edge shim rules
verbs.summary: Reflect over execution reports (went_right, went_wrong, unknowns, latency and token burn) to emit zero-model < 2 ms routing, context-pruning and failure-guardrail shims.
verbs.outcome: Deterministic edge shim rule set hashed with SHA-256 and verified under the 2.0 ms latency ceiling.

slots.name: execution_episodes
slots.description: Pin of prior Task execution reports with went_right and went_wrong notes.

steps: Compile multi-round miss and failure episodes into high-specificity trigger rules and context-pruning directives.
Measure evaluate_shim wall-clock latency to confirm < 2.0 ms execution.

acceptance.check: Every compiled shim rule carries a rule_sha256 and evaluates in < 2.0 ms with zero model calls.

verbs.title: Verify bounded DGM-H self-improvement proposals with an independent verifier
verbs.summary: Gate bounded retrieval and shim improvement proposals by checking proposer != verifier, zero holdout regressions, positive MRR lift and surface_only visibility.
verbs.outcome: Conforming verification receipt rejecting self-approval (409) and approving only independently verified non-regressing proposals for owner review.

slots.name: proposal_bundle
slots.description: Pin of quarantined DGM-H proposal and holdout benchmark metrics.

steps: Verify proposer_worker_id != verifier_worker_id and proposer_key_id != verifier_key_id.
Confirm mutates_evaluator_controls is false, visibility_scope is surface_only, holdout_regressions == 0 and shim latency < 2.0 ms.

acceptance.check: Self-verification is rejected and distinct-actor verification validates against template.sira-analogy-receipt.
